name: Eye of the Storm
blurb: Passive: Whenever  Janna's abilities  slow or  knock up at least one enemy  champion, she  refunds a portion of  Eye of the Storm's cooldown.

effects.description: Passive: Whenever Janna's abilities slow or knock up at least one enemy champion, 20% of Eye of the Storm's cooldown is refunded. This may occur once per spell cast.
Active: Janna grants the target allied champion or turret, or herself, a shield for 4 seconds.
While the shield holds, the target gains bonus attack damage.

notes:
Eye of the Storm has a  forgiveness radius of 175 units.
Janna receives kill credit on enemy champions that are killed by turrets shielded by Eye of the Storm.
Allied turrets will benefit from the bonus attack damage when targeted by Eye of the Storm.
